suite: Cargo handshake and buyer settlement integration
suiteFil: Cargo handshake at buyer settlement integration
detail: Pickup rejection, valid pickup, delivery, and buyer settlement passed. Order creation failed with HTTP 500 because OrderController::store does not exist at this historical commit. Dependencies followed the committed lockfile, which Composer warned is out of sync with composer.json. The Windows-only ext-pcntl installation check was bypassed; no worker or signal behavior was tested. Used an in-memory database and a synthetic application key; notifications were faked. This result does not establish the behavior of a newer deployment.
detailFil: Pumasa ang pickup rejection, valid pickup, delivery, at buyer settlement. Nabigo ang order creation sa HTTP 500 dahil wala ang OrderController::store sa historical commit na ito. Sinunod ang committed lockfile; nagbabala ang Composer na hindi ito tugma sa composer.json. Nilaktawan ang ext-pcntl installation check sa Windows; walang worker o signal test. In-memory database at synthetic key ang ginamit, at fake ang notification. Hindi nito pinatutunayan ang kilos ng mas bagong deployment.

Other controller tests, rollback contents, and audit guarantees were not exercised by this selected run.
detailFil: Pumasa ang referenced assertion para sa disposed-asset transfer sa HTTP 422. Database name lamang sa temporary fixture ang pinalitan ng natatanging schema na tiniyak munang wala bago ang test. Nasa nakasaad na commit ang application code at assertion. Inalis ang temporary schema matapos ang test; hindi binago ang orihinal na test database at working repository. Hindi saklaw ang ibang controller test, nilalaman ng rollback, at audit guarantee.
